documents.title: Electrical safety
documents.text: Before resetting a tripped circuit breaker, isolate the electricity supply and inspect the circuit. Only a qualified electrician should repair damaged wiring.

documents.title: Plumbing response
documents.text: For a leaking pipe, close the main water valve. A plumber replaces damaged pipe joints and checks water pressure.

documents.title: Refund processing
documents.text: Refunds return the captured payment to the original payment method. Payment reconciliation compares gateway records against ledger entries.

documents.title: Professional allocation
documents.text: Professional allocation checks service radius, availability and arrival time. Booking offers expire after the acceptance timeout and then the system reassigns the booking.

documents.title: सफाई सेवा
documents.text: सफाई सेवा के लिए ग्राहक को पता और समय बताना चाहिए। सफाई कर्मचारी उपलब्ध होने पर बुकिंग की पुष्टि के लिए ग्राहक से अनुमति ली जाती है।
